concept: South Moon BBQ smokehouse palette: warm cream backgrounds like butcher paper, a deep smoky brick-red primary pulled from seasoned ribs, a charred-orange/amber accent like glowing coals, and dark charcoal-brown ink. Rustic, hearty, bold and appetizing.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA targets verified against --color-bg (#FBF4E9). ink on bg 16.49:1 (>=7); ink-soft on bg 7.69:1 (>=4.5); white on primary 7.53:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg 6.89:1 (>=3). Extras: white on primary-dark 11.3:1, white on secondary 10.11:1, white on accent 4.40:1 (AA for large/UI text), accent on bg 4.03:1, ink on surface 17.72:1, ink on surface-alt 14.73:1.
